verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents an official CLI covering project/resource management, function deployment, non-interactive/headless CI use, SDK generation, and self-hosted endpoint targeting, which is well suited to AI-native/agentic automation workflows. missing for 10: independent hands-on community corroboration of the CLI itself (evidence is entirely first-party docs) and no explicit example of an AI agent scripting the CLI end-to-end.
